author: Nick Strum
title: Looking for visual artist to visualize energy for app
content:
#Numerologists on X speak in code. Myself included.

Now I want to bring that code to life inside @cuetheapp

We’re looking for an exceptional visual artist who can make energy something people can see and feel.

Original ideas. Real craft. More soul.

We’re putting together a creative contest to find artists we can hire and build with.

DM me your artwork, sketches, or your own interpretation of energy. Show me how you see it.

Tag an artist who should see this.

Want to create with CUE? Join our talent pool and apply with examples of your work: cuetheapp.com/job https://www.cuetheapp.com/job
